dependencies.use: checkpoint header digests (vocab pin, data binding, payload); first unit of the core build, its `export fn` lines rewritten to `fn`

test_oracles.role: Python stdlib referee for target/mask, reference policy and decode prefixes; verification only, never in the build

host_tools.name: sh, cat, cp, cmp, dd, od, head, tail, cut, tr, wc, sha256sum
host_tools.role: build concatenation, byte flips and comparisons in build.sh and run-core.sh; verification and glue only
host_tools.omega_replacement: none needed for the product path; the binaries are self-contained static ELF from omc

host_tools.name: sed
host_tools.role: rewrites `export fn` to `fn` in the pinned SHA unit (program mode refuses export)
host_tools.omega_replacement: an omc unit-link mode that accepts exported library units (omega-mv proposal)

host_tools.name: jq
host_tools.role: reads the pins from this file in build.sh

host_tools.name: git
host_tools.role: extracts the SHA unit at its pinned commit

host_tools.name: python3
host_tools.role: runs tests/omegese45/core/oracle.py (stdlib only), the independent referee
host_tools.omega_replacement: none; an oracle must be independent of the implementation

product_claim: bounded host CPU training of a small dense next-token model; no transformer, no GPU
